div.head: II Cn 72.1
div.ab: And gif se bonda, ær he dead wære, beclypod, þonne andwyrdan þa yrfenuman, swa he sylf sceolde, þeah he lif hæfde.
And gif se bonda, ær he dead wære, beclypad wære, þonne andwirdan þa erfenumen, swa he sylf sceolde, þeah he lif hafde.
Et si compellatus in uita sua fuerat in aliquo, respondeant heredes eius, sicut idem deberet, si uiueret.
And gyf se bunda, ær he dead wære, wære beclypad, ðonne andwyrde ða yrfnumen swa he sylf sceolde, ðeah he lif hæfde.
And gif se bonda, ær he dead wære, beclypod wære þonne andwyrdan þa yrfenuman swa he sylf sceolde, þeah he lif hæfde.
And if the householder had been cited before his death, then his heirs shall answer the charge, as he himself would have done, had he been alive.
And if a claim had been made against the householder before he died, then his heirs shall respond to the claim as he himself would have had he lived.
And if the householder was cited before he died, then the heirs are to answer as he would have had to, if he were alive.
Wenn jedoch jener Hofbesitzer, bevor er todt war, verklagt worden ist, dann müssen die Erbnehmer sich verantworten, wie er selbst müsste, wenn er Leben hätte.
If, however, that householder was accused before he was dead, then the heirs must answer, as he himself would have to if he had life.
div.note: G omits ‘wære’ after ‘beclypod’; Liebermann supplies it from the other MSS. Liebermann compares III Atr 14.
